// The readers differ only in the fp32 add order (qk_group). So the envelope is
  // relative to the absolute-product mass: 1e-4 of it plus 1e-6.
body:
**[comments] Rule 5, a call-site comment says only why here: shorten**

The bf16, fp32 and fp16 sentences restate the per-query-type contract written on qk_group in h/tron/kernels/k_vnni.hpp, and the fp16-widened sentence restates the names q_f16_widened and dot_f16_widened. The dead-token sentences are already carried next to their operands by lines 230, 232 and 263. What stays is why the envelope has this shape.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // The readers differ only in the fp32 add order (qk_group). So the envelope is
  // relative to the absolute-product mass: 1e-4 of it plus 1e-6.
```
